data.name: Crew: Expendable
data.detailed_description:
Crew: Expendable is an up to 7-player co-op game with social deduction/betrayal and extraction elements. You are a member of a space engineering team independently contracted by the pharma-colonial conglomerate Oroboros, who must travel to the recently abandoned  Hesperides Station to discover what led to its breakdown and the disappearance of all staff.

 

A Silicon Alien Lifeform (S.A.L.) prowls the halls of Hesperides. This lethal entity will stalk and hunt down anyone it comes across, and is seemingly impervious to conventional attacks. As you and your team complete assignments and cash in salvage across the station, you must evade this creature's claws by hiding, finding tools to stave it off, and working together. Perhaps you can even find a way to kill it before it kills you.

 

The Silicon Alien Lifeform is not the only danger in the game. One member of your team is on a secret assignment from Oroboros to not only ensure the survival of the alien, but to make sure they are the only one left to return alive from Hesperides Station. The Corp Agent will covertly work to sabotage the team's efforts on the station while completing classified assignments of their own to improve their chances of survival.

 

Teamwork and vigilance are key to making it back home alive. Collaborate on assignments to change the station in useful ways and unlock new rooms and tools that will help keep the Silicon Alien Lifeform from killing you. Discover a means to stop it once and for all, but never forget the human beside you might be the one to throw you to the claws for a paycheck bonus.

data.short_description: Explore Hesperides Station in this co-op sci-horror social deduction game, where a Silicon Alien Lifeform prowls the halls. Work together with a team of seven to complete assignments and stop the lethal creature- or betray everyone in the name of Oroboros StarCorp.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Inter Core i5 Series / AMD Ryzen 5 Series
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia 2000 Series / AMD 5000 Series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Inter Core i7 Series / AMD Ryzen 7 Series
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia 3000 Series / AMD 6000 Series
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: The game has a dark atmosphere. Players can die through various means, including death by being shot by other players or the in-game monsters.
